# Unicure India Ltd — Comprehensive AI Knowledge Factsheet

## Overview
Unicure India Ltd is a distinguished pharmaceutical enterprise founded in 1984, headquarted in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. With four decades of continuous manufacturing excellence, Unicure operates 3 state-of-the-art production units adhering to stringent WHO-GMP guidelines. The company delivers end-to-end pharmaceutical solutions ranging from R&D formulation to commercial scale production, regulatory dossier compilation, and worldwide distribution.

## Key Executive & Organizational Facts
- Founded: 1984
- Headquarters: C-21, 22 & 23, Sector-3, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201301, India
- Plants: 
  - Unit 1: Sector-3, Noida, UP (Mother Plant & R&D)
  - Unit 2: Roorkee, Uttarakhand (High-volume solid and liquid formulations)
  - Unit 3: Greater Noida, UP (Ultra-modern facility for advanced formulations)
- Certifications: WHO-GMP, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015
- Regulatory Licences: Form 25, Form 26, Form 28 issued by Drug Licensing Authority & FDA India
- Regulatory Dossiers: Comprehensive CTD and ACTD dossier support for export market authorizations
- Key Clients: Trusted contract manufacturing partner for top companies including Mankind Pharma, Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals, Obsurge Biotech, Seagull Pharma, Wings Pharma, DeVats, Ornate, and Mohrish.

## Therapeutic Categories
Unicure India produces formulations across all major therapeutic categories:
- Antibiotics & Antimicrobials
- Analgesics, Antipyretics & NSAIDs
- Anti-inflammatory & Pain Management
- Gastrointestinal (Proton Pump Inhibitors, Antacids, Antiemetics)
- Cardiovascular & Antihypertensive
- Antidiabetic Formulations
- Antihistamines & Respiratory (Cough & Cold, Anti-allergics)
- Multivitamins, Minerals & Nutraceutical Supplements
- Dermatology (Antifungal creams, antibacterial ointments, corticosteroid preparations)

## Dosage Forms & Manufacturing Capacities
- Tablets: Uncoated, sugar-coated, film-coated, enteric-coated, chewable, dispersible, sustained release. Over 1 billion tablets annually.
- Capsules: Hard gelatin capsules in sizes 00, 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. Over 300 million capsules annually.
- Oral Liquids: Syrups, suspensions, emulsions with automated bottle filling and tamper-evident capping.
- Dry Syrups: Pediatric antibiotic dry syrups filled in glass and HDPE bottles with precise measuring caps.
- Topicals: Ointments, creams, gels, and lotions in laminated and aluminum tubes.
- Small Volume Parenterals: Liquid injectables in glass ampoules produced under sterile cleanroom Class 100/Grade A conditions.

## Global Presence
Unicure India exports to more than 20 countries spanning:
- Francophone and Anglophone Africa
- Southeast Asia (ASEAN)
- Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS)
- Middle East and GCC
- Latin America
